title: Correct N1 expression
description: Essential: Student must state or derive N1 = mg / cosθ (or equivalent).

title: Correct N2 expression
description: Essential: Student must state or derive N2 = mg tanθ (or equivalent).

title: Maximum mass condition
description: Essential: Student must give the final answer for part (2) as m_max = ((√3 + 1)/2) M.

title: Force balance on ball
description: Important: Student must apply equilibrium conditions (vertical and horizontal) to the ball.

title: Force balance on cube
description: Important: Student must apply equilibrium (horizontal and vertical) to the cube, identifying friction and normal forces.

title: Friction inequality setup
description: Important: Student must relate horizontal force on cube (N2) to maximum static friction μN_ground.

title: Normal force from ground
description: Optional: Student correctly calculates the total normal force on the cube-ground system as (M+m)g.

title: Angle substitution
description: Optional: For part (2), student correctly substitutes θ=45° (tan45°=1) into the inequality.

title: Sign or force direction error
description: Pitfall: Student misidentifies the direction of N1, N2, or friction, leading to incorrect equations.

title: Friction force confusion
description: Pitfall: Student uses friction coefficient incorrectly (e.g., applies it to the ball-cube interface) or misapplies the inequality sign.
